name: Remix amazon.in Landing Page
description:
Remix this e-commerce landing page for my oil brand "Olira". Replace the water bottle content and Material Flask branding with Olira oil while keeping the clean editorial layout, hero section, visual showcase, feature highlights, and interactive product configurator.

Brand & Hero Section:
- Brand Name: Olira
- Headline: Pure cold-pressed goodness. (or "Crafted for everyday kitchens.")
- Subheadline: Pure, thoughtfully sourced oil made for everyday cooking, flavor, and wellness—clean pouring with zero mess.
- Primary & Secondary CTAs: "Shop Olira" and "Explore"

Visual & Feature Sections:
- Show Olira oil bottles in studio and kitchen/lifestyle scenes (warm natural lighting, marble/wood counter, fresh ingredients).
- Highlight key benefits in feature cards/stats: e.g., Purity / Cold-Pressed or Smoke Point / Shelf Life, plus Drip-Free Pour Cap, UV-Protected Bottle, and Quality/Sourcing details.

Interactive Product Configurator (matching the right-side buy box layout):
- Title: Olira Oil
- Variant / Finish options (like bottle edition or oil variant): e.g., Cold-Pressed Classic, Extra Light, Signature Blend
- Size / Capacity options (matching the 3-size selector): e.g., 500 ml, 1 L, 2 L
- Specs summary rows: Purity/Extraction, Best For, Packaging/Guarantee
- Add to Bag button with dynamic price based on selected variant and size.
